Treatment summary
This summary describes the care provided to a patient who presented following a
low-speed collision in a parking lot and sustained a fracture of the wrist. The
reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash.
Initial imaging and physical examination clearly confirmed the fracture, and
immobilization and supportive care were started promptly. Over the course of twenty
visits, treatment followed a typical progression, with frequency of visits tapering as
the patient's range of motion, grip strength, and pain levels improved steadily. No
prior injury to the same area of the body is known from the patient's history or
records. Billing reviewed for this episode of care shows no repeated or duplicate
charges for services rendered. The patient is now discharged from active treatment
with a stable healing pattern, and follow-up is recommended only if symptoms recur.
